name: Pimoroni Tiny 2350
description: Postage-stamp (23x18 mm) RP2350A with 4 MB flash, USB-C, RGB LED, Qw/ST (Qwiic/STEMMA QT) connector and castellated pads for $9.
notes: 12 IO pads including 4 ADC channels; the Qw/ST I2C connector uses GP12/GP13; BOOT button doubles as a user switch on GP23.
Also sold with pre-soldered headers (about $13); 3V3 regulator limited to about 300 mA; input 3-5.5 V.
Early boards use RP2350 A2 silicon with erratum E9 (add external pull-downs of 8.2 kOhm or less for pulled-low inputs).
